title: Lightning Garage
subtitle: 2023 F-150 Lightning ER Lariat • FORScan Menu, .abt/.ab Parser & VIN Companion
description: 100% Deterministic FORScan Mod Menu (59 F-150 recipes sorted by popularity & EV risk tier), ISO 3779 + NHTSA vPIC VIN Decoder (1FT6W1EV4PWG11434 Extended Range 131 kWh), .abt & Motorcraft .ab XML Importer/Differ, Live Nibble Mask & Checksum Engine, 87-Module Guide, and In-Cab Session Planner.
tagline: 2023 F-150 Lightning ER Lariat FORScan Mod Menu, Deterministic As-Built .abt/.ab Parser & Checksum Companion

quickstart.step: Verify Your Truck & VIN (`⚡ Truck & VIN`)
quickstart.detail: Launch Lightning Garage to view your pre-loaded 2023 F-150 Lightning ER Lariat (`1FT6W1EV4PWG11434`, 131 kWh Extended Range, 320 mi EPA). Tap `🌐 Verify w/ NHTSA vPIC` anytime to confirm factory BEV telemetry.

quickstart.step: Load a Baseline (`.abt` / `.ab` or `🧪 Demo Baseline`)
quickstart.detail: Tap `📂 Import .abt / .ab File` to load your real FORScan `.abt` module backups or Ford Motorcraft `.ab` XML—or tap `🧪 Load Demo Baseline` to preview live nibble mask and checksum dry-runs immediately.

Filter all 59 F-150 recipes by `🔥 Most Common (★★+)`, module (`726 BCM`, `7D0 APIM`, `720 IPC`, `740/741 DDM/PDM`), or Risk Tier (`T1 Cosmetic`, `T2 Behavior`, `T3 Locked`). Tap any card to inspect exact `BEFORE -> AFTER` hex bytes and recomputed checksums.

quickstart.step: Run Your In-Cab FORScan Session (`📋 Session Plan`)
quickstart.detail: Open the `📋 Plan` tab in the truck cab with your OBDLink EX. Follow the 12V pre-flight checklist, verify every target module has a saved `.abt` backup, and copy or share your exact line-by-line write sheet.

navigation_map.purpose: Offline ISO 3779 + NHTSA vPIC VIN decoder, readiness KPIs, 1-tap Demo Baseline loader, and JSON Vault export/import.
Searchable FORScan mod catalog sorted by popularity and risk tier with live nibble-mask & checksum dry-run drawer.
Complete Ford control module directory (`726`, `7D0`, `720`, `706`, `7E7`, `746`, etc.) with EV notes, write-risk ratings, and backup evidence.
Pre-flight module backup coverage checker, `.abt`/`.ab` importer, Factory vs. Current byte drift differ, Motorcraft AsBuilt helper, and Checksum Calculator.
Printable/shareable in-cab FORScan write sheet grouping required module backups and exact target hex lines.

deep_dive_features.title: 100% Deterministic Nibble Mask & Checksum Engine (`Code -> Never LLM`)
deep_dive_features.body: Evaluates `set`, `bits`, and `offset` nibble operations across multi-step recipes with rolling same-address state compounding and recomputes exact Ford line checksums (`sum(header + data[:-1]) & 0xFF`).

deep_dive_features.title: 3-Tier Safety Gating & EV Applicability Filtering
deep_dive_features.body: Automatically locks Tier 3 safety/HV/powertrain/ADAS modules (`7E7 BECM`, `746 SOBDMC`, `760 ABS`, `730 PSCM`, `706 IPMA`) and flags `ICE_ONLY` gas-engine recipes so they cannot be accidentally scheduled on your Lightning.

deep_dive_features.title: Ford Motorcraft `.ab` XML & FORScan `.abt` Diffing
deep_dive_features.body: Parses both plain-text FORScan `.abt` backups and official Ford Motorcraft `.ab` XML files directly on your phone, surfacing byte-by-byte factory drift and hardware part numbers (`F111`, `F113`, `F188`).

pro_tips: Always save an untouched FORScan `.abt` backup of every target module before writing changes, and import the post-write `.abt` afterward to confirm exact byte matches.
Tap `📤 Export Vault (.json)` on the Truck tab to back up your starred mods, personal notes, and imported `.abt`/`.ab` baselines across devices.
